world_class.label: World Class (Sigma ≥ 6.0)
world_class.description: Rule: 1_3s (N=2, 1 run/day), minimal false rejection, defect rate < 3.4 DPM

marginal.label: Marginal (3.0 ≤ Sigma < 4.0)
marginal.description: Rule: Full Multirule + 8_x or 10_x (N=4 to N=6, multiple runs)

poor.label: Unacceptable / Poor (Sigma < 3.0)
poor.description: Analytical method redesign, calibration overhaul, or reagent troubleshooting required.

Title: SigmaLab QC (Sub: Clinical Six Sigma & Biological Variation Suite)
Active Lab Selector or Instrument Filter quick badge

Tabs/Pills navigation: 1. Calculator & Live Simulation, 2. Biological Variation Database (EFLM/Ricos), 3. Normalized Method Decision Chart (OPSpecs), 4. Lab Records & History, 5. Report Generator (PDF/Excel)
Quick Action: '+ New Test Record' CTA button

layout_and_navigation.grid_structure: Mode A & Mode B hybrid. Main analytical cockpit uses high-density 12-column grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6`).

features: Interactive inputs: Analyte selection with autofill from Westgard/EFLM database OR manual custom specification
Fields: Analyte Name, TEa% (Total Allowable Error), Measured CV% (Imprecision), Measured Inaccuracy / Bias%, Instrument / Platform (e.g., Roche Cobas, Abbott Alinity, Beckman DxC, Siemens Atellica)
Calculated metrics: Sigma = (TEa% - Bias%) / CV%, Quality Goal Index (QGI) = Bias% / (1.5 * CV%) to identify whether imprecision or systematic bias is the problem
Visual Sigma Gauge: Dynamic SVG semi-circular gauge / linear gradient scale (0 to 7) with pointer indicating calculated metric
Recommended Westgard Rules card: Automatic QC design recommendations (Rules sequence, Control Measurements N, Runs per day, Error detection probability Ped vs False rejection Pfr)
Quick 'Save to Lab Records' action triggering instant history log update
Preloaded comprehensive database of 40+ key clinical analytes (Electrolytes, Renal, Liver, Cardiac, Lipids, Endocrinology, Hematology, etc.) based on EFLM & Westgard Desirable specifications

Columns: Analyte Name, Sample Matrix (Serum/Plasma/Urine/Whole Blood), Within-Subject CVI%, Between-Subject CVG%, Desirable Imprecision I% (≤0.50 CVI), Desirable Inaccuracy Bias% (≤0.25 (CVI²+CVG²)^0.5), Desirable TEa% (1.65*I + Bias or EFLM standard)
Search bar with live filtering by category, name, or matrix
One-click 'Use in Calculator' button on each analyte row
Detailed drawer/dialog explaining EFLM Milan hierarchy & BIVAC quality criteria
Recharts-based Normalized OPSpecs & Normalized Method Decision Chart (Normalized Inaccuracy % vs Normalized Imprecision %)
Diagonal benchmark contour lines for Six Sigma (6σ, 5σ, 4σ, 3σ, 2σ)
Scatter points for all lab records or current simulated analyte
Interactive hover tooltip with Analyte, Instrument, Sigma value, and Operating coordinates
Legend and visual performance zones (World Class, Excellent, Good, Marginal, Poor)
Full CRUD: Add record, Edit CV%/Bias%, Delete, Filter by Instrument or Analyte
History timeline / Line chart showing Sigma metric evolution over monthly QC runs
Pre-seeded with realistic clinical lab data (e.g. Glucose on Cobas c502, Troponin I on Alinity i, Creatinine on DxC 700, HbA1c on Tosoh G8)
Bulk export options and filter by status (At Risk vs Target met)
Printable / Clean PDF-ready format (window.print() with @media print CSS styles and custom lab header)
Excel/CSV export using dynamic CSV blob download with all metrics, Westgard rules, dates, and instrument tags
Executive Quality Summary showing % of tests meeting 6-sigma world class vs tests needing action

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete React frontend in JavaScript (.js and .jsx files). Use existing dependencies: lucide-react, recharts, sonner, tailwindcss.
Implement comprehensive Biological Variation preloaded dataset (at least 30-40 clinical chemistry, immunochemistry, and hematology analytes with TEa%, CV%, Bias%).

Implement the Westgard QC Rule recommendation algorithm: Sigma ≥ 6 -> 1_3s (N=2); 5.0-5.9 -> 1_3s/2_2s/R_4s (N=2); 4.0-4.9 -> 1_3s/2_2s/R_4s/4_1s (N=4); 3.0-3.9 -> Multirule + 8_x (N=4 or 6); <3.0 -> Method Unacceptable (Requires redesign).

Include Method Decision Chart with Recharts: Normalizing Inaccuracy% on Y-axis (0-100% of TEa) and Imprecision% on X-axis (0-50% of TEa), drawing Six Sigma reference contour lines (y = 100 - sigma * x).
Persist lab records to localStorage so user changes survive reloads, and provide realistic initial seeded lab records for testing.
Support full CSV export and a dedicated formatted Print view for PDF reporting.
All testable buttons and inputs MUST include the specified data-testid attributes.
